verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Trivy has an official GitHub Action (aquasecurity/trivy-action) and is described as easy to integrate into CI/CD pipelines. That gives a path to running scans on pull requests in GitHub. However, nothing in the pack documents findings appearing as PR comments, check annotations, or SARIF code-scanning results, and GitLab is not mentioned. Missing for 10: documented PR comment or check-annotation output, SARIF/code-scanning upload, GitLab merge-request integration, hands-on corroboration of findings shown in PRs.
